stories.title: Trump e Xi alla cena di Stato: “Fatta la storia, nuovo modello di convivenza”. Accesso negato ai giornalisti

en.title: Trump and Xi at State Dinner: "History Made, New Model of Coexistence". Press Access Denied
en.summary: Trump and Xi attended a White House gala following their summit, with major U.S. tech representatives among the guests. The event was not broadcast on television, continuing tensions between Trump and major broadcasters over denied media access.

stories.title: Xi: 'Cina e Usa devono esplorare un nuovo modello di convivenza tra grandi nazioni'

en.title: Xi: 'China and USA Must Explore New Model of Coexistence Between Major Nations'
en.summary: Xi stated that China and the United States had sincere and substantive exchanges, with common understanding on many issues.

stories.title: Decreto scuola, il 30% di stranieri nelle prime e sanzioni per il burqa. Cosa cambia in classe

en.title: School Decree, 30% Foreign Students in First Classes and Sanctions for Burqa. What Changes in Classrooms
en.summary: New school regulations effective next year impose a 30 percent limit on foreign students in first-year classes and fines on families not attending language lessons. Children born in Italy who completed at least two years of preschool are exempt from these limits.

stories.title: Tasse, tutto il peso dell’Irpef su un terzo dei contribuenti. “Nove milioni pagano zero”

en.title: Taxes, Full Weight of Income Tax Falls on One-Third of Taxpayers. "Nine Million Pay Zero"
en.summary: A report reveals fiscal system asymmetry, with one-third of Italians bearing most tax burden, primarily employees and pensioners, while nine million citizens pay no taxes.

stories.title: Aula semi vuota all’Onu mentre Netanyahu parla: molte delegazioni lasciano l'Assemblea

en.title: Semi-empty hall at UN while Netanyahu speaks: many delegations leave the Assembly
en.summary: Multiple diplomats walked out of the UN assembly in New York with some booing as Netanyahu addressed the gathering. Netanyahu responded with sharp criticism of the protest.

stories.title: Decreto legge scuola, come funziona il tetto del 30% di alunni stranieri in classe

en.title: School Decree: How the 30% Cap on Foreign Students in Class Works
en.summary: A new school decree establishes regulations based on Italian language proficiency requirements for foreign students in classrooms.

stories.title: Scuola, Meloni rivendica il decreto su tetto agli stranieri e divieto di velo

en.title: School: Meloni Defends Decree on Cap for Foreign Students and Veil Ban
en.summary: Prime Minister Meloni defended government policies restricting foreign students and banning veils in schools, characterizing them as necessary measures to promote genuine inclusion.

stories.title: Netanyahu all’Onu, molte delegazioni lasciano la sala. E lui: genocidio a Gaza, la bugia del secolo

en.title: Netanyahu at UN, Multiple Delegations Leave During Speech. He Calls Gaza Genocide "the Lie of the Century"
en.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu addressed the UN General Assembly as numerous diplomatic delegations departed the chamber in protest during his remarks.

stories.title: Proteste per Netanyahu all’Onu, arrestata Susan Sarandon

en.title: Protests against Netanyahu at the UN, Susan Sarandon arrested
en.summary: Demonstrations took place around the UN headquarters, with several people detained during the protests.

stories.title: Scuola, ok al decreto: tetto del 30% agli stranieri nelle prime classi e burqa vietato

en.title: School: Decree Approved with 30% Cap on Foreign Students in First Classes and Burqa Ban
en.summary: A school decree was approved establishing a 30% cap on foreign students in initial grades, banning full-face veils, and including free language courses and fines for non-compliance with Italian language requirements.

stories.title: Xi Jinping alla Casa Bianca, tregua sui dazi e cena di Stato (boicottata dai media)

en.title: Xi Jinping at the White House, tariff truce and State dinner (boycotted by media)
en.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping announced a new trade agreement during his White House visit. The two sides showed alignment on artificial intelligence, while Beijing paused actions on Taiwan, though major U.S. television networks did not broadcast the official dinner.

stories.title: Scuola, ok al decreto. Meloni: “Stop burqa e niqab”. Tetto del 30% di stranieri nelle classi

en.title: School, decree approved. Meloni: "Stop burqa and niqab". 30% cap on foreign students in classes
en.summary: Italy approved education measures including mandatory free Italian courses for foreign parents with language barriers and a cap on foreign students, with sanctions for non-compliance.

stories.title: All’Ospedale di Niguarda una “Casa” per le famiglie dei bimbi in pediatria

en.title: A "House" for families of children in pediatrics at Niguarda Hospital
en.summary: A new 600-square-meter facility was inaugurated in the pediatrics department at Niguarda Hospital in Milan, expanding Casa Ronald McDonald Italia Ets' presence within the hospital.

stories.title: Hitachi Rail lancia il primo intercity elettrico a batteria. Trenitalia ne ha ordinati sei

en.title: Hitachi Rail launches first battery-electric intercity train. Trenitalia has ordered six
en.summary: Hitachi Rail introduced its first battery-electric intercity train, manufactured in Pistoia and Naples facilities. The train operates on both electrified lines and in battery mode with 100 kilometers of range on non-electrified routes, with Trenitalia placing an order for six units.

stories.title: Terra Madre Salone del Gusto, oltre mille eventi all’insegna della biodiversità

en.title: Terra Madre Salone del Gusto, over one thousand events celebrating biodiversity
en.summary: The Terra Madre Salone del Gusto event is organizing more than one thousand events focused on biodiversity, following a coordination meeting held in Pollenzo the previous year.

stories.title: Da Nestlé a Nespresso a Redion, così Bocconi fa lavorare (e laureare) detenuti

en.title: From Nestlé to Nespresso to Redion, how Bocconi works with (and graduates) prisoners
en.summary: Bocconi University's prison project provides employment and educational opportunities for incarcerated individuals through partnerships with major companies including Nestlé, Nespresso, and Redion.

stories.title: Advanced control solutions acquisisce Ksenia Security e Dea Security

en.title: Advanced control solutions acquires Ksenia Security and Dea Security
en.summary: Advanced control solutions, controlled by Investindustrial, has completed agreements to acquire Ksenia Security and Dea Security, two Italian companies, as part of consolidating Italian-made security capabilities.
